issuer: Advisory Committee of the Supreme Court of Missouri / Office of Legal Ethics Counsel
title: Missouri Informal Ethics Opinion 930085
text: QUESTION: May attorney enter into a contingent fee arrangement to collect on final judgment which was entered in a domestic relations case? Because payments to client as a result of collection action will be in installments over a lengthy period, may attorney require that client irrevocably designate attorney as payee of the payments? ANSWER: The contingent fee arrangement is not prohibited. The irrevocable assignment implicates Rule 1.8(a) on conflicts of interest.
